summary_zh: 本页是绘本的封面或标题页，展示了书名《一闪，一闪，小星星》、作者Jane Cabrera和出版社Holiday House New York，背景为蓝色夜空和一颗黄色的星星。

Twinkle, twinkle, little star,
I wonder what you are.

page_text_en:
Twinkle, twinkle, little star, the whole world wants to know what you are.
Tonight, you will twinkle and shine upon the entire earth.
